name: Hubstaff
description: Hubstaff is a workforce management and time tracking platform that combines desktop, web, and mobile timers with automated timesheets, GPS location tracking, activity levels, screenshots, and payroll integrations.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Includes time tracking, timesheets, and basic activity tracking (2-seat minimum).

tiers.name: Grow
tiers.notes: Adds advanced reporting, URL & app tracking, and 1,500 screenshots/seat/mo (2-seat minimum).

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Adds unlimited screenshots, shift scheduling, payroll integrations, and client invoicing (2-seat minimum).

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Adds VIP support, SOC 2 compliance, and custom account provisioning.

best_for: Positioned for remote teams, hybrid companies, field service crews, agencies, and contractors needing unified time tracking, proof-of-work monitoring, scheduling, and automated payroll.
pros: Comprehensive workforce tracking with optional proof-of-work screenshots and activity rates
Built-in automated payroll integrations with PayPal, Wise, and Payoneer
GPS location tracking and geofencing for mobile field service teams
Cross-platform support across desktop, mobile, and browser extensions
cons: 2-seat minimum required on Starter, Grow, and Team paid plans
Screenshot and keystroke activity monitoring may face employee privacy resistance
Invoicing and automated payroll features require Team tier or higher
features: Multi-platform time tracking with desktop, mobile, web, and Chrome extension timers
Automated timesheets with manager approvals and overtime calculation
Proof-of-work monitoring including customizable screenshot frequency and activity rates
App and URL usage tracking with productivity classification
GPS location tracking and geofenced job sites for field teams
Employee shift scheduling and attendance monitoring with missed-shift alerts
Automated payroll and contractor payments via PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, and Bitwage
Client invoicing based on tracked billable hours and customizable pay rates

alternatives.name: Toggl Track
alternatives.description: A time tracking tool with one-click timers, background activity tracking, and profitability reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting intuitive timer tracking without invasive employee monitoring

alternatives.name: Time Doctor
alternatives.description: An employee time tracking and workforce productivity platform with screencasts, distraction alerts, and payroll.
alternatives.best_for: BPOs and remote teams needing detailed employee monitoring and distraction alerts

alternatives.name: Clockify
alternatives.description: A time tracking and timesheet app with attendance, scheduling, and a free plan for unlimited users.
alternatives.best_for: Budget-conscious teams needing free basic time tracking and timesheets

alternatives.name: Harvest
alternatives.description: A time tracking and invoicing software designed for teams and freelancers to track project hours and bill clients.
alternatives.best_for: Agencies and consultancies needing streamlined time tracking tied directly to client invoicing
